- **Balanced Performance:** The Ryzen 5 5500U offers excellent multitasking capabilities for note-taking, browsing, and light programming or design work.
- **Portability:** Weighs only ~1.8 kg, making it easy to carry around campus.

The **HP 15s** is the most budget-friendly option but lacks the processing power and battery life of the other two, making it less ideal for heavy workloads.
